strings.privacy.title: Pilikino
strings.privacy.description: Pehea e mālama ai ʻo pdffusion i kāu mau faila: ʻaʻohe moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe palapala i mālama ʻia, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha a ʻaʻohe kūʻai aku i ka ʻikepili.
strings.privacy.intro: Ua kūkulu ʻia ʻo pdffusion i noho nō kāu mau palapala nou. Eia, ma ka ʻōlelo maʻalahi, ka mea e hana ʻia ke hoʻohana ʻoe iā ia.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Kāu mau faila
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Hoʻouna ʻia lākou me ka hoʻopaʻa ʻia (HTTPS), hana ʻia ma ke ʻano ʻakomi, a laila holoi ʻia i ka wā e mākaukau ai ka hopena. Hele nā faila nui ma o ka waihona kuikawa ma lalo o kekahi inoa pōhina a holoi ʻia i ka pau ʻana o ka hana; hoʻopau ka hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻakomi i nā mea a pau i koe i loko o 24 hola ka lōʻihi.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: ʻAʻohe moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe ʻikepili pilikino
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: ʻAʻole noi ʻo pdffusion i ke kau inoa, ka helu leka uila, ʻaʻole hoʻi i ke kāleka hōʻaiʻē. ʻAʻole loa e heluhelu ʻia, nānā ʻia, kaʻana ʻia a hoʻohana ʻia kāu mau palapala no ka hoʻ taʻahiko ʻana i ka naʻauao hana.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ana kipa
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Helu mākou i nā kipa me ka ʻike ʻole ʻia a me ka ʻole o nā kuki (Vercel Web Analytics) e ʻike ai i nā mea hana e pono ana. ʻAʻohe hoʻolaha, ʻaʻohe nānā paena keʻa.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Nā kuki
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Hoʻokahi kuki wale nō, koho wale nō: hoʻomanaʻo ia i ka ʻōlelo i koho ʻia e ʻoe.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Hoʻipaʻa kikowaena
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Hoʻipaʻa ʻia ka paena e Vercel ma nā kikowaena ma Palika; mālama ʻia nā hoʻololi Word, Excel a me PowerPoint e Render ma Frankfurt. Hoʻohana wale kēia mau mea hoʻolako i nā faila no ka lōʻihi o ka hoʻololi ʻana.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kāhea iā mākou
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: He nīnau a manaʻo paha? E hoʻokaʻaʻike mai iā mākou mai ka ʻaoʻao papahana:
strings.legal.terms.title: Nā kūlana hoʻohana
strings.legal.terms.description: He manuahi ʻo pdffusion no nā mea apau, me nā ʻoihana a me nā aupuni. Nou nō kāu mau palapala: ʻaʻole i kālailai ʻia a mālama ʻia paha kekahi mea.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Ke alakaʻi nei kēia mau kūlana i kāu hoʻohana ʻana iā pdffusion. He pōkole loa lākou a ua kākau ʻia ma ka ʻōlelo maʻamau. Ma ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka pūnaewele, ʻae ʻoe i kēlā mau mea.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: ʻO wai ka mea hoʻopuka iā pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: Ua hoʻolālā, kūkulu a hoʻopuka ʻia ʻo pdffusion e Mikailou Cedric Toure, he mea polokalamu ma New Brunswick, Kanakā.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: He laikini hoʻohana manuahi no nā mea apau
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: He manuahi ʻo pdffusion, me ka no inoa ʻole a me ka palena manawa ʻole, no nā mea apau: kānaka, haumāna, kumu, ʻoihana, hui aloha ʻole, hoʻomalu lehulehu a me nā aupuni, ma Kanakā a ma kekahi ʻāina ʻē aʻe. ʻAʻole i mālama ʻia kekahi hoʻohana no kahi papahana uku, no ka mea ʻaʻohe mea. ʻO nā waihona āu e hana ai nou wale nō: ʻaʻohe hōʻailona wai a ʻaʻohe ʻōlelo no pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Kāu mau palapala apau, ʻo nā mea hūnā hoʻi
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Hiki ia ʻoe ke hana i kekahi ʻano palapala, me nā mea hūnā, no ka mea, ʻaʻole heluhelu, kālailai, mālama a kaʻana ʻo pdffusion i kāu mau waihona: hana ʻia lākou me ka ʻakomi a laila holoi ʻia. ʻO ʻoe nō ka mea nona, a na ʻoe e kuleana no ka loaʻa ʻana o nā pono e hana ai iā lākou.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Ke kumu code a me ka hoʻokomo ʻana ma kāu mau kikowaena iho
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Ua paʻi ʻia ke kumu code o pdffusion ma lalo o ka laikini MIT. Hiki ia ʻoe ke heluhelu, nānā, hoʻokomo ma kāu mau kikowaena iho (me ka pūnaewele pani ʻole i ka Pūnaewele), hoʻololi a hoʻӀоhaʻi manuahi, ke mālama ʻoe i ka hoʻolaha kuleana kope a me ka kikokikona laikini.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Hoʻohana ʻae ʻia
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: ʻAʻole hiki ia ʻoe ke hoʻohana iā pdffusion no ka hana hewa, hoʻopilikia i ka lawelawe (hoʻouka nui ʻakomi, hoʻāʻo komo) a i ʻole ka pale ʻana i kona mau palena ʻenehana. Ke pale nei ka nui a me ka palena helu waihona i ka lawelawe no nā mea apau.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Loaʻa
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: Hāʻawi ʻia ʻo pdffusion me ka uku ʻole. Hiki ke loli, hoʻopau no ka mālama ʻana a i ʻole ke hoʻopau ʻia. E mālama mau i kāu mau palapala kumu: ʻaʻole mālama ʻo pdffusion i kope o lākou.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Palapala hōʻoia a me kuleana
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Hāʻawi ʻia ka lawelawe “e like me ia”, me ka palapala hōʻoia ʻole o kekahi ʻano. I ka palena nui i ʻae ʻia e ke kānaka, ʻaʻole kuleana ka mea hoʻopuka no nā pōʻino ʻē aʻe, ka nalowale ʻikepili a i ʻole ka hopena hoʻololi hewa. E nānā i nā palapala āu e hana ai ma mua o ka hoʻohana ʻana no kekahi mea nui.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Kuleana waiwai naʻauao
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: No ka mea hoʻopuka ka inoa pdffusion, kona hōʻailona a me nā kikokikona o ka pūnaewele; aia ke code ma lalo o ka laikini MIT e like me ka mea i hōʻike ʻia ma luna. No ko lākou poʻe nona nā hōʻailona i haʻi ʻia (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…).
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Kānaka hoʻomalu
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Hoʻomalu ʻia kēia mau kūlana e nā kānaka o ka Panalāʻau o New Brunswick a me nā kānaka pekelala o Kanakā e pili ana ma laila. Aia ka mana i nā ʻaha o New Brunswick, me ka ʻole o ka hōʻino ʻana i nā kuleana e hāʻawi ʻia e ke kānaka o kou ʻāina iho ma ke ʻano he mea kūʻai.

strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Hiki ke hoʻohou ʻia kēia mau kūlana. Hōʻike ka lā ma luna o ka ʻaoʻao i ka mana i mana; pili wale ka hoʻololi i ka hoʻohana ma hope o kona paʻi ʻana.

strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: He nīnau e pili ana i kēia mau kūlana? E kākau mai iā mākou mai ka ʻaoʻao papahana:
strings.legal.security.title: Palekana a me ka ʻikepili
strings.legal.security.description: He aha ka mea e loaʻa i kāu mau waihona ma pdffusion: ka hana ʻakomi, ka loiloi ʻole, ka holoi koke ʻana, ka hoʻ کوډ ʻana, ka hoʻokipa ʻana ma ʻEpela, a me ke koho e hoʻokomo ma kāu mau kikowaena iho.
strings.legal.security.intro: He aha ka mea e loaʻa i kāu mau waihona, ma hea e hana ʻia ai a pehea e pale ʻia ai: ua wehewehe ʻia maʻalahi, no nā kānaka a me nā keʻena ʻenehana.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: ʻAʻole mālama ʻia nā palapala
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Hana ʻia kāu mau waihona me ka ʻakomi, a laila holoi ʻia ke mākaukau ka hopena a i ʻole i hoʻoiho ʻia. ʻAʻohe kope, ʻaʻohe kākoʻo a ʻaʻohe mōʻaukala. Hoʻopau pū kekahi holoi ʻakomi i kēlā me kēia lā i nā waihona manawa e koe paha, i ka lā aʻe ma ka lōʻihi.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Loiloi ʻole
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: ʻAʻole heluhelu kekahi i kāu mau palapala. ʻAʻole i kūmole ʻia, kālailai, kaʻana a hoʻohana ʻia paha e hoʻ taʻa i ke akamai kūlohelohe. ʻAʻohe moʻokāki o pdffusion, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha a ʻaʻohe pili mea hoʻohana.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Hoʻ کوډ ʻana
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Hoʻ کوډ ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻopili ʻana (HTTPS) a hoʻoikaika ka pūnaewele i ka hoʻ کوډ ʻana i kēlā me kēia kipa ʻana (HSTS). Hoʻ کوډ ʻia e ka mea hana Palekana kāu mau PDF me AES-256; ʻaʻole mālama ʻia ka huaʻōlelo huna āu i koho ai.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Ma hea e hana ʻia ai kāu mau waihona
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Nā mea hana pūnaewele, PDF a me kiʻi: Vercel, kikowaena ʻikepili Palika (Palani, Hui ʻEpela). Nā hoʻololi Word, Excel a me PowerPoint: Render, ma Frankfurt (Kelemānia, Hui ʻEpela). Nā waihona ma luna o 4 MB: waihona manawa Vercel Blob, ma lalo o ka inoa pōʻino, holoi ʻia ma hope o ka hoʻohana ʻana.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Nā pale ʻenehana
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Nā poʻo palekana (HSTS, ka pale ʻana i ka pūnaewele mai ka hoʻokomo ʻana ma nā ʻaoʻao ʻē aʻe, ka pale ʻana i ka huikau ʻano waihona), nā wahi waihona manawa ʻaʻole hiki ke hōʻoia ʻia, a me kahi lawelawe hoʻololi e ʻae wale ana i nā noi e lawe ana i kahi hōʻailona hūnā. strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Pilikino a me ke kānaka pili

strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: He aha ka mea i hoʻokumu ʻia
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Hana ka pūnaewele apau me ke kīpuni, me ka loulou “Lele aku i ka ʻike” a me ka palena ʻike ma ka mea hana. ʻO ka ʻokoʻa kikokikona ma kahi o 4.5:1. strings.tools.renommer.seoTitle: Inoa hou i nā waihona ma ka Pūnaewele — manuahi, ʻaʻole i hoʻouka ʻia kekahi mea
strings.tools.renommer.seoDescription: E inoa hou i hoʻokahi a i ʻole nā waihona he nui (PDF, Word, nā kiʻi…) i ka manawa hoʻokahi, me ka helu ʻakomi. Hana ʻia nā mea apau i kāu polokalamu kele pūnaewele: ʻaʻole i hoʻouka ʻia kekahi mea.

strings.tools.images.seoDescription: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia kiʻi, kiʻi kiʻi a me ka hōʻailona mai loko mai o kahi PDF ma ke ʻano he PNG a JPG paha, me ka ʻole o nā kope. Manuahi, ʻaʻohe kau inoa, holoi ʻkoma ʻia nā faila.
strings.tools.images.intro: Hoʻokuʻu i kahi PDF: loaʻa i ka pdffusion kēlā me kēia kiʻi i loaʻa a hāʻawi iā ʻoe kekahi ma hope o kekahi, ma ke ʻano he PNG a JPG paha, i loko o kahi waihona ZIP. Waiho ʻia nā kiʻi hoʻonaninani liʻiliʻi a me nā kope.

strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].text: PNG no ka maikaʻi loa, JPG no nā faila māmā.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].title: Kaomi Wehe i nā kiʻi
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].text: Loaʻa iā ʻoe nā kiʻi a pau i loko o kahi waihona ZIP.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].q: Pehea e ʻokoʻa ai kēia mai ka hoʻololi ʻana i kahi PDF i JPG?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].a: Hoʻololi ke kulu i kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao holoʻokoʻa i kiʻi. Loaʻa i ka wehe kiʻi wale nō nā kiʻi a me nā kiʻi kiʻi i loko o nā ʻaoʻao, ma ko lākou nui kumu.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].q: No ke aha i nalo ai kekahi mau kiʻi?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].a: Hana ʻia ka lele ʻana ma luna o nā kiʻi liʻiliʻi (nā kiʻi, nā kiko) ma ke ʻano paʻamau: kaha i "Mālama pū i nā kiʻi liʻiliʻi". ʻAʻole he kiʻi ka kikokikona a me nā kiʻi kiʻi vector, no laila ʻaʻole i wehe ʻia.
strings.tools.redimensionner.name: Hoʻololi nui / ʻoki

strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Hoʻololi nui a ʻoki i nā kiʻi ma ka pūnaewele no ka manuahi
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: E hoʻēmi i kahi kiʻi (ma ka % a i ʻole i nā pika) a ʻoki paha i ka huinahā, 16:9 a i ʻole 4:3, a laila mālama iā ia ma ke ʻano he JPG, PNG a i ʻole WebP. Manuahi, ʻaʻohe kau inoa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Hoʻokuʻu i kāu mau kiʻi, koho e hoʻēmi a ʻoki paha, nānā i ke kiʻi mua, a laila kaomi Hoʻololi nui / ʻoki. Kūpono no ke kiʻi pili, kahi mea hoʻopili kaumaha loa a i ʻole palapala e koi ana i ka nui kikoʻī.

strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[2].text: Hoʻoiho ʻoe i nā kiʻi i hoʻoponopono ʻia.

strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].a: He liʻiliʻi nā pika o ke kiʻi liʻiliʻi akā noho ʻoi ma kona nui hou.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].q: Ma hea i hana ʻia ai ka ʻoki?
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].a: Ma waenakonu o ke kiʻi: ʻoki ʻia nā kihi e hiki ai i ke kāhua i koho ʻia, e like me ka hōʻike ʻana o ke kiʻi mua.
